tiers.exact_finite: W(3,3) Ihara/graph-RH statements with explicit graph scope
tiers.classical_standard: completed-xi identities, functional equation, argument principle
tiers.equivalent_reformulation: Li/Weil/de Branges or defect-energy criteria stated as equivalences
tiers.candidate_bridge: operator, determinant, trace-formula, or limiting constructions without equality
tiers.classical_solution: permitted only with an explicit transfer theorem and complete proof

required_for_classical_solution_claim: exact equality with the completed xi function or its zero set
